name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.1.3.

Today, rebuilt: one screen to run the day. Money expected at the top (customers who tapped Pay on your link), then who to chase, then the few things only you can decide. Numbers and aging sit to the side.

You are told when money may be coming: a Windows notification the moment a customer taps Pay on your payment link, with the amount and the bill. The tray shows how many payments are expected. Nothing is ever marked paid until you post it.

Party page: the whole story on one line, newest first. Bills, reminders, link opened, tapped Pay, promises, receipts.

Pay link for your customers: pick bills, pay 25%, 50%, full or any amount; the page suggests the top-up that clears the next bill; large amounts route to your bank details.

Smoother start: services start one after another so other apps are not slowed; screens no longer go blank after a sync; typing is never interrupted by a background refresh.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
